purpose: Teach: 精通/バネ/急上昇/弁理/全編/特段/ジャッジ/発進

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、専門分野に精通しろ
lines.en: Ren, become expert in your field.
lines.style: Measured, direct. Authoritative without harshness. Slight pause after the name. Weight of expectation — not doubt, conviction. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究者として精神のバネを保ちます
lines.en: Yes. I'll keep my mind sharp as a researcher.
lines.style: Respectful but not servile. Genuine commitment in the voice. Quick affirmative, then a beat before elaborating. Quiet determination underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、引用数急上昇の論文を学べ
lines.en: Ren, study the papers with rising citations.
lines.style: Same steady authority. Slight emphasis on the instruction itself. Not a question, not a suggestion. The tone of someone who knows exactly what matters.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究成果の弁理士相談も検討します
lines.en: Yes. I'm also considering consulting with a patent attorney about my research.
lines.style: Engaged and thinking ahead. Small breath before the second thought — showing he's processing, not just agreeing. Respectful but not stiff.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文の全編を精査しろ
lines.style: Firmer than before. The word 'thoroughly' carries weight. Not a casual ask — this matters. Steady, uncompromising tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。特段に重要な実験は再現します
lines.en: Yes. I'll reproduce the critical experiments myself.
lines.style: Quiet confidence. Not rushing. Shows he understands the gravity. Deliberate pacing on the key commitment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、データのジャッジは公平にしろ
lines.style: Shifts slightly — less about method, more about integrity. Slow, meaningful delivery. A principle being stated, not an instruction. Direct gaze.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究プロジェクトの発進を準備します
lines.en: Yes. I'm preparing to launch the research project.
lines.style: Final affirmation — broader scope now. Confidence settling in. Slightly firmer close than previous responses. Signal of readiness, not just obedience.
